properties.name: WHAT WORKED (hxm_program, 2026-09-28): the root-cause skill ordered a live hardware incident (a motion-controller axis fault) the design did not model. It refuted the agent's own first inference within one message, and it closed with "root cause: NOT established" instead of "fixed by power cycle"
properties.statement:
Recorded so a regression is checkable. Reporter (the hxm_program hub, 2026-09-28, an operations incident on a detector motion axis): "its steps set the order of the work before anything was reset: symptom as observation, including what is NOT affected; precedent search; at least three candidates; a distinguishing measurement; 'say what you could not establish'." Concretely, the agent compared the faulted axis's status against two healthy axes on the same controller. That comparison refuted its own "kill-when-idle" inference within one message. It added the vendor's brake hypothesis as a candidate with a predicted signature, and closed with "root cause: NOT established". The reporter: "The skill earns its place even when the graph holds nothing."
The same hub reported this three times on 2026-09-09/10: the first plausible cause was wrong each time, and step ④ killed four candidates in one reading.
What must not regress: the steps still order the work, and step ⑨ still permits "not established", when no design node exists for the failing part.
The gaps beside it are triaged separately. The incident produced no design node (F-30), and step ② could not search the hub's file archive of past fixes (F-31).
